# freethedesk

> freethedesk builds websites and operational systems for Australian small and medium businesses and vehicle dealerships: connected sites, online licensing and business automation rather than template brochureware.

Perth-based, working with businesses across Australia. The differentiator is the admin side. Supplier stock syncs, instant staff notifications, precomposed transactional emails and booking-system integrations sit behind every site built, not just the public-facing pages.

## Services
- [Website development](https://www.freethedesk.com.au/website-development): Custom websites and web applications for small and medium businesses, built around automation that saves staff time rather than a marketing site alone.
- [Business automation](https://www.freethedesk.com.au/automation): Workflow automation and custom integrations connecting the systems a business already runs.
- [SEO reports and audits](https://www.freethedesk.com.au/seo): Human-written quarterly SEO reporting and audits covering technical health, content and search opportunities. Not AI-generated.
- [Dealer websites](https://www.freethedesk.com.au/dealers): Inventory, parts, service and hire websites built specifically for vehicle and equipment dealerships.
- [Online vehicle licensing](https://www.freethedesk.com.au/licensing): Online vehicle licensing and contract signing so customers can complete paperwork without a dealership visit.
- [Dealership website builder](https://www.freethedesk.com.au/dealership-website-builder): An interactive configurator for specifying a dealership website around how a business sells, books and grows.

## Case studies
- [Scooter Shop](https://www.freethedesk.com.au/portfolio/scooter-shop): A live dealership website covering inventory, online purchasing, licensing, parts, service and hire, and the organic growth that followed.
- [Bloomprint](https://www.freethedesk.com.au/portfolio/bloomprint): A two-sided flower delivery marketplace with brief-led ordering for customers and paid local orders for independent florists.

## Guides
- [Guides and articles](https://www.freethedesk.com.au/guides): Practical field notes for Australian dealerships on websites, search visibility, online sales, licensing and operational systems.
